The '''steepara tree''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dressel/Legends|Dressel]]. [[Forest/Legends|Forests]] of steepara trees covered much of the planet and were home to creatures such as the [[cuirreal climber]]. The [[Steepara seed|seeds]] and [[Steepara syrup|syrup]] of the steepara tree were an important part of the diet of the [[Dressellian/Legends|Dressellian]] species.<ref name="Stay" />
